06040580bf20c1f9ea64ba81871619126aac07c8.sourceText: 调整时要一起看前两项：本项变大，粗候选减少，但内部精搜索范围会变宽；本项变小，粗候选增多，但精搜索范围会变窄。源码按round(总范围／步距)+1取候选数，宜保持范围与步距能够合理分段，不能把粗、细两项当成互不相关的独立旋钮。
06040580bf20c1f9ea64ba81871619126aac07c8.translatedText: When tuning, the first two items should be considered together: if this item increases, the coarse candidates decrease, but the internal fine search range widens; if this item decreases, the coarse candidates increase, but the fine search range narrows\.
